package members_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	pb "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/pb"
	members "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/members"
)

func TestMounted(t *testing.T) {
	e := &members.Endpoints{
		Mount: func(_ context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
			input := req.(*members.MountEndpointInput)
			return nil, input.Stream.Send("mount:" + input.Payload)

		},
		MountH: func(_ context.Context, req any) (any, error) {
			input := req.(*members.MountHEndpointInput)
			return nil, input.Stream.Send("mountH:" + input.Payload)

		},
	}
	ctx, client := mountedClient(t, e)
	input := "input"
	one, err := client.Mount(ctx, &pb.MountRequest{Field: &input})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	value, err := one.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "mount:input", value.GetField())
	_, err = one.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
	two, err := client.MountH(ctx, &pb.MountHRequest{Field: &input})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	value2, err := two.Recv()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "mountH:input", value2.GetField())
	_, err = two.Recv()
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
}
